subject: Vendor onboarding — PO form mapping & split-Net quarterly billing proposal
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Valdez <sara@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + billing cadence questions

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for signing the SOW last week. We're just kicking off vendor activation on our side and I had a couple quick questions so AP has the right mapping before the first invoice: 

- Do you send a single PO per quarter or per invoice line item? (We saw both approaches during onboarding)
- Which PO field do you use for cost-center vs. project code? Our template expects "CostCenter" and "ProjectID" but some customers put them in the "Notes" field.
- Billing cadence: does Atlas prefer Net 30, Net 45, or Net 60? Any constraints around quarterly consolidated invoices?

I've attached the PO_Form_Atlas_v1.pdf you shared last month and our Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.xlsx for mapping. If it's easier, we can propose a split-Net option: consolidated quarterly invoice with Net 30 for the first payment window and Net 60 for recurring support items — could help smooth cashflow on your side while keeping us predictable.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync this week to confirm the exact fields? If not, a quick email reply listing the exact PO fields we should map would work.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_Form_Atlas_v1.pdf (pdf), Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (excel)

From: Sara Valdez <sara@atlashealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Huang <procurement@skyline-inc.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + billing cadence questions

David —

Quick answers below and apologies for the long list — procurement is juggling a month-end close: 

- We issue one PO per vendor per quarter for platform agreements; however we often add invoice-level line items on the PO for exceptions.
- Cost center should be mapped to the PO field labeled "GL_ACCOUNT" in our system; Project codes live in "PROJECT_CODE". If you map to those two fields we can automate match.
- Atlas standard is Net 45. We can accept Net 30 for onboarding invoices if an early-pay discount is applied. Net 60 is atypical for our AR team and requires Finance sign-off (possible but slower).

We prefer consolidated quarterly invoices via our portal (portal.atlashealth.com). For a split-Net proposal: Finance will want to see the sample invoice cadence and how you flag which line items fall into the faster window.

I've attached our W9 and the fully completed PO_Form_Atlas_v1.pdf you requested.

Regards,
Sara Valdez
Sr. Procurement Manager — Atlas Health
Attachments: PO_Form_Atlas_v1.pdf (pdf, completed), W9_AtlasHealth.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + billing cadence questions

Forwarding Sara's note — key takeaways for AP and Onboarding team: 

- Map Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Template.xlsx columns -> Atlas: "CostCenter" -> GL_ACCOUNT, "ProjectID" -> PROJECT_CODE. 
- Target: support consolidated quarterly invoice via portal + keep one onboarding invoice as Net 30 if they accept a 0.5% early-pay discount for that one payment. Finance asked for the sample cadence and flagging approach.

Proposal (draft):
1) Onboarding invoice (first month): consolidated invoice, Net 30 with 0.5% early-pay discount if paid within 15 days.
2) Ongoing quarterly invoices: consolidated, Net 45 standard.
3) For any third-party pass-throughs, tag line item metadata with "fastpay=true" to indicate eligibility for the onboarding Net 30 window.

Laura — can you draft the short clause and a sample invoice showing the flagging? I can own the PO-field mapping with Atlas once we have the sample.

-Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
